title: Filter Restaurants by Vegan-Friendly, Price and Distance
summary: Given an array of restaurants with their IDs, ratings, vegan-friendliness, prices, and distances, filter the list based on vegan-friendliness, maximum price, and maximum distance.
statement: Given an array of restaurants with their IDs, ratings, vegan-friendliness, prices, and distances, filter the list based on vegan-friendliness, maximum price, and maximum distance. Return the IDs of the filtered restaurants, sorted by rating in descending order and by ID in descending order for ties.
constraints: Sort accepted IDs by rating descending then ID descending.
hints: The vegan flag is required only when vegan_friendly equals one; price and distance use inclusive limits.
Sort rows by negative rating then negative ID and return IDs.
The compound key implements both descending priorities exactly.
editorial: The compound key implements both descending priorities exactly.

tests.explanation: Vegan filtering leaves IDs 3,1,5 in rating and ID order.
Equal ratings use descending ID, producing 2 then 1.
